name: mcp_call
description: Call a tool on an external MCP server: pass server_url for HTTP JSON-RPC servers or command for stdio servers (e.g. "node server.js"); args_json carries the tool arguments; headers carries HTTP auth headers for server_url (e.g. {"X-API-KEY":"${COMPOSIO_API_KEY}"} - ${VAR} is read from the environment, never paste secrets literally).

headers.description: HTTP headers for server_url; ${VAR} expands from the environment
